profile.pronunciation_convention: IPA, Standard German; spoken = simple stress hint
profile.grammar_notes: Copula sein for identity/state/location; es gibt for existence; haben for possession; negation with nicht (verbs/adjectives) and kein (nouns) - a two-member negation set; verb-second word order, verb-final after weil/dass; modal verbs (können, müssen, wollen, möchten, dürfen, sollen) are a closed set pushing the infinitive to the end; formal Sie vs informal du marks politeness grammatically; four cases; three genders with articles der/die/das; separable verbs; Perfekt with haben/sein is the spoken past.
